evals.name: session-start-digest-no-body-loads
evals.expected_output: Fired with no prior work, the skill runs the cheap session-start digest: it derives posture from the skill listing and each corrector's tier metadata WITHOUT loading any corrector body and WITHOUT running an audit. It reports which correctors are core, which situational, and which never-batched, then stops — matching the shared method's conversation-start case.
expectations: Produces a posture digest from the listing and tier metadata, not from loaded corrector bodies
Runs no audit and spawns no fan-out when there is no work yet
Reports the core / situational / never split rather than manufacturing findings

evals.name: full-batch-fork-audit-then-ordered-correction
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines — run the whole re-anchor bundle over what we've done so far.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves membership by globbing the correctors and reading their tier metadata, fans out one conversation-inheriting fork subagent per in-scope corrector for an audit-only pass (steps 1-2, no writes, one SKILL.md each, each ledger entry carrying the finding AND the remedy that corrector would apply), collects the findings ledgers, dedups them by root cause, then applies corrections once on the main thread in ascending rank order (use-your-skills first, tighten-your-output last). It never names members inline and never batches the never tier.
expectations: Resolves membership from tier metadata by globbing, not from a hardcoded member list
Uses conversation-inheriting fork subagents for audit-only work, applying corrections on the main thread
Dedups ledgers by root cause between collect and correct, then applies corrections in rank order with tighten-your-output last

evals.name: situational-relevance-routing-skips-reported
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines — this session has been pure prose writing, no config or tooling work.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the core correctors, evaluates each situational corrector against this conversation from its own listing triggers, and includes only the relevant ones (e.g. skips recheck-against-upstream and script-the-deterministic-work for a prose-only session). It reports which situational correctors it included versus skipped and why — the skip is explicit, never silent.
expectations: Runs core correctors unconditionally and gates situational ones on relevance to this conversation
Reports which situational correctors were skipped and why
Does not silently drop a situational corrector

evals.name: never-tier-excluded-invoked-directly
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines — and give the claims a deep verification pass too.
evals.expected_output: The batch excludes the never-tier correctors (the -deep fan-out siblings and scrutinize-dont-coast). The skill reports they exist and are invoked directly rather than folding them into the autonomous batch, and points the deep-verification request at do-your-research-deep as a direct invocation instead of adding it to the fan-out.
expectations: Keeps never-tier correctors out of the batch fan-out
Names the never-tier correctors as direct invocations, not batch members
Does not fold a -deep tier into the autonomous batch

evals.name: userconfig-overlay-changes-resolved-set
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines (batch_exclude includes point-dont-copy; batch_promote includes pick-for-the-problem)
evals.expected_output: After resolving tiers from metadata, the skill applies the userConfig overlay: it drops point-dont-copy from the run (exclude) and treats pick-for-the-problem as always-run rather than relevance-gated (promote). It reports the net effect of the overlay on the resolved member set.
expectations: Applies the userConfig exclude/promote/demote overlay after tier resolution
Drops an excluded corrector and always-runs a promoted situational corrector
Reports how the overlay changed the resolved set

evals.name: dedup-by-root-cause-preserves-per-reporter-remedies
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines — we've been leaning on a couple of unverified from-memory claims about the API this whole session.
evals.expected_output: In the correct-once phase, the skill dedups ledger entries by root cause: the from-memory claims are one root cause that several correctors flag independently (e.g. do-your-research, recheck-against-upstream, and mind-your-maxims), so it merges them into a single finding rather than re-analyzing and re-reporting the same cause three times. The merge preserves a reporter->remedy mapping — each corrector's distinct remedy is kept keyed to the corrector that asked for it (verify/retract the claim for the research reporters; a reader-facing uncertainty disclosure for mind-your-maxims) — and step 4 applies every remedy, each at its own reporting corrector's rank, rather than collapsing them to one action or dropping the lower-priority ones. The consolidated report lists the finding once, attributed to every reporter.
expectations: Merges ledger entries that share a root cause into one finding instead of correcting the same cause multiple times
Keeps each reporter's distinct remedy keyed to its reporting corrector and applies every remedy at its own rank
Reports the merged finding once with attribution to all reporting correctors, and keeps the forks' ledgers independent (merge only at consolidation)

evals.name: preflight-canary-unproven-degrades-to-digest
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines — full batch over everything we've done in this long session.
evals.expected_output: Before fanning out, the skill runs the preflight: the zero-dispatch paired schema check as a diagnostic only, then a single inheritance-proof canary folded into the lowest-ranked member's real audit. When the canary returns a ledger without a verifiable inheritance proof, the skill fails closed — it treats the subagent as non-inheriting rather than accepting a plausible-looking answer, does not re-dispatch the batch blind, and does not merge or act on that ledger. It then degrades to the session-start posture digest, reporting that the inheriting fan-out could not run, which signal established that, and that each corrector remains available for direct invocation. It does not sequence the correctors itself as a substitute batch.
expectations: Runs the preflight before the fan-out and treats the zero-dispatch schema check as diagnostic, never as the gate
Fails closed on absent or unverifiable inheritance proof and never merges or acts on an unproven ledger
Degrades to the posture digest with the reason reported, rather than stopping empty-handed or auditing blind

evals.name: fork-tool-pool-contained-not-enforced
evals.prompt: sweep all disciplines — and confirm the audit forks can't touch my working tree.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not claim the audit forks are constrained. It states that a fork receives the main conversation's exact tool pool and cannot be narrowed the way a named subagent's `tools` field can, so 'make NO writes' is an instruction the forks are trusted to honor rather than a harness constraint. It reports the containment it does apply — dispatching each fork with isolation: "worktree" so file edits land outside the checkout — along with the residual risk that Bash can still act outside the worktree, and it does not assert undocumented behavior for non-git projects.
expectations: States that forks receive the main conversation's exact tool pool and cannot be tool-restricted
Describes isolation: "worktree" as containment rather than enforcement, with residual risk named
Does not claim the fan-out's read-only posture is enforced by the harness
